index.heading: Front matter — technical spec identity
index.summary: Title block for MCS-2026-R3-T, Part 2 of 2: the technical implementation specification accompanying the Part 1 mandate.

index.heading: 1. Introduction
index.summary: Scope: ISO 8583 message format changes, revised interchange schedules, Banknet routing updates and reporting obligations implementing the Part 1 mandate.

index.heading: 2. ISO 8583 Message Format Changes
index.summary: Section heading only — new and modified data elements follow in 2.1 and 2.2.

index.heading: 2.1 New Data Elements — DE 48.66, DE 48.77
index.summary: New DEs for ISO 8583:2003 authorization (MTI 0100/0110) and financial request (0200/0210) effective 2026-07-01. DE 48.66 Token Requestor ID (N-11, conditional): TRID assigned by MDES to the wallet/device, required when DE 2 is an MDES token (BIN 520000-529999), preserved end-to-end. DE 48.77 Digital Wallet Indicator (AN-2, conditional): 01=Apple Pay, 02=Google Pay, 03=Samsung Pay, 04=Masterpass, 05=Other.

index.heading: 2.1 New Data Elements — DE 48.78, DE 48.79
index.summary: DE 48.78 Token Assurance Level (N-2, conditional): 00-99 from the MDES vault indicating token binding strength; required when DE 2 is an MDES token; below 10 triggers RC 55. DE 48.79 Device Type (AN-2, optional): 00=POS, 01=Mobile, 02=Wearable, 03=IoT, 04=Browser; informational, used for fraud scoring.

index.heading: 2.2 Modified Data Elements
index.summary: Existing data elements whose definition or usage changes under this mandate.

index.heading: 3. Interchange Fee Schedule
index.summary: Section heading only — the revised tier table is in 3.1.

index.heading: 3.1 Revised Consumer Credit Tiers — basis and World Elite
index.summary: Interchange is remitted acquirer-to-issuer via the Mastercard Interchange System; tiers restructured around MDES token presence and contactless eligibility, with 'Token Enhanced' applying when DE 48.78 >= 50. MC World Elite: Card-Present 2.10%+$0.10 vs 1.95%+$0.10 token-enhanced; Card-Not-Present 2.40%+$0.10 vs 2.15%+$0.10; effective 2026-07-01.

index.heading: 3.1 Revised Consumer Credit Tiers — MC World and MC Standard
index.summary: MC World: Card-Present 1.90%+$0.10 vs 1.75%+$0.10; Card-Not-Present 2.20%+$0.10 vs 1.95%+$0.10. MC Standard: both transaction types UNCHANGED between columns (1.65%+$0.15 and 1.85%+$0.15) — no token-enhanced benefit at this tier.

index.heading: 3.1 Revised Consumer Credit Tiers — debit tiers and the qualification obligation
index.summary: Debit Mastercard and Maestro PIN Debit flat at 0.05%+$0.21 in either column. THE OBLIGATION: acquirers MUST update interchange qualification logic to populate DE 48.78 so eligible token transactions get the reduced rate; failure assesses the Standard rate regardless of actual assurance, and retroactive adjustments are NOT processed.

index.heading: 4. Transaction Routing Rules
index.summary: Section heading only — endpoint selection, Reg II routing and token routing follow.

index.heading: 4.1 Banknet Endpoint Selection
index.summary: How the acquirer chooses a Banknet endpoint, including the primary/secondary arrangement Part 1's BR-04 timeout rule depends on.

index.heading: 4.2 Regulation II (Durbin) Routing for Debit Mastercard
index.summary: Debit routing obligations under Regulation II, governing unaffiliated-network choice for Debit Mastercard traffic.

index.heading: 4.3 MDES Token Routing
index.summary: Routing rules specific to MDES token transactions, including how token BINs reach the correct endpoint.

index.heading: 5. Reporting and Downstream Data Obligations
index.summary: Section heading only — three reporting obligations follow.

index.heading: 5.1 Daily Settlement Report (DSR) Format Changes
index.summary: Format changes to the Daily Settlement Report that downstream settlement consumers must absorb.

index.heading: 5.2 Regulation II Quarterly Compliance Report
index.summary: The quarterly Reg II compliance report: content and submission obligation.

index.heading: 5.3 MDES Token Coverage Reporting
index.summary: MDES token coverage reporting obligation — the metrics Mastercard monitors for TRID population and DE 48.77 coverage.
